text: Rust requires every mutable reference to be unique so it can prove a value is changed through only one path at a time. That rule prevents data races and the wider class of memory-safety bugs from aliased mutation, such as iterator invalidation.
thought:
Rust prevents two mutable references to the same value because that would allow data races. This restriction eliminates the data race bug class.

The borrow checker also prevents aliasing bugs like iterator invalidation and use-after-free issues when mutating through one reference while reading through another.
